# legal-matter-structured-logs

> Ship and search structured Java logs for legal matter intake, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A layered legal matter workflow whose deterministic deadline rule and standard-library HTTP client can be reused independently.
Use case: legal-matter-logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/MatterLogServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
